title: .env to Kubernetes Secret YAML

seo.title: .env to Kubernetes Secret YAML — Private, Browser-Based Draft Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Generate clear base64-encoded data and visibly warn that base64 does not encrypt anything.
seo.h1: Convert a local .env file into Kubernetes Secret YAML

requirements.runtime: browser, compiled via existing lazy route loader

input: textarea and optional file local read
limitations: This converter does not evaluate shell variables. Kubernetes Secrets are not encrypted simply because values are base64 encoded. Avoid committing manifests containing real credentials.
